newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two hurt as police break up Brazil protest.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt as police break up Brazil protest.

text.p: A protest by unionists and civil servants in northeastern Brazil turned into a battle with military police after crowds tried to storm a city council chamber, national Globo television reported on Tuesday.
Globo said two people had to be hospitalized in the city of Fortaleza, capital of Ceara state, after police ploughed into the protesters swinging batons and firing into the air.
The demonstrators were protesting against plans by the city council to slash public payrolls and eradicate at least three city secretariats.

Fortaleza is one of dozens of Brazilian cities trying to cut costs by reforming its over-staffed bureaucracy. After decades of patronage and financial irresponsibility, many states now spend 90 percent of their income on staff salaries and pensions.
